messages:
sara_ml: Bringing up xgen-3-small (INT8) on the eval harness. Unit tests pass but the runner crashed on a few long-context evals — attaching crash log.

sara_ml: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "eval_runner.py", line 412, in run_batch
    kv_cache.copy_from(src)
RuntimeError: KV cache copy failed: allocation size mismatch (quantized path)
```

raj_engineer: Seen this locally. Looks like the kvcache memcpy path doesn't handle q8 byte strides. Quick fix is to use kv_view() and memcpy per-chunk.

mike_infra: CI job 4827: runner OOM + also discovered artefact s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/4827/user_prompt_samples/testcases.json contains raw customer emails and some dev notes. Not good.

ci-bot: CI job 4827 reported: runner OOM at step 342, exit_code=137, artifact archived -> s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/4827

olivia_privacy: This is a potential data-leak. We need to treat it as PII exposure until proven otherwise. @mike_infra can you snapshot access logs and revoke public access? Legal should be looped in.

sara_ml: I've opened a PR that (a) patches the kv cache path to avoid the crash, (b) adds a default redact stage before uploading prompt corpora. PR: https://git.redwood/merge/1234. The redact util is simple regex-based for now.

raj_engineer: Regex alone will be brittle. For eval realism we sometimes need placeholders that look like emails. Suggest we hash email-like tokens with a per-team salt and preserve token-length distribution. That keeps tokenization behavior stable.

olivia_privacy: hashing + per-team salt + KMS-managed key is acceptable. No reversible mappings in CI artifacts. Also require ACLs on the bucket to limit access to eng-ml and infra SAs.

mike_infra: I'll put an ACL on the bucket and enable SSE-KMS. Also will rotate any pre-signed URLs that were leaked. Plan to replace raw prompt files in 4827 with redacted versions. ETA: today EOD.

eva_research: Important: some eval metrics depend on entity presence (e.g., NER recall, entity-level F1). If we replace entities with hashed tokens we should ensure the metrics are computed equivalently. Maybe inject synthetic placeholder tokens that preserve span boundaries.

sara_ml: Good point. I added a --pii-mode flag to the runner: zero|hash|tokenize. Default is hash. Example: ```bash ./run_eval --pii-mode=hash dataset.yaml``` Tests added: eval-harness/test_redaction.py covers token counts and span mapping.

raj_engineer: Also pushed the kv cache fix to the branch. Switched memcpy to guarded per-byte copy and fixed quantized stride calc. No more crashes on long contexts. CI passed on my fork.

mike_infra: I revoked public-read on the artifacts path and applied a 7-day retention for raw prompt artifacts. Rotated KMS alias and invalidated old presigned URLs.

olivia_privacy: Opening incident ticket INC-2025-17. Notifying legal and security. We'll need a short blurb for any impacted customers if their prompts were included.

sara_ml: Plan: merge PR after one more review, run backfill job to overwrite old artifacts with redacted outputs, and add a CI gate to fail jobs that try to upload unredacted prompt files when dataset flag contains_customer_data=true.

raj_engineer: Small implementation note: annotate eval result metadata with "pii_mode": "hash" so dashboards know what pre-processing applied. Also make dashboard tooltips show that some entity-based metrics are affected by masking.

eva_research: Agreed — also add a synthetic-replacement strategy that keeps token count and approximate byte-length so metrics that rely on tokenization don't drift. Add unit that compares original vs redacted token lengths (must match).

mike_infra: I'll add an S3 bucket policy to deny PutObject unless a CI header X-Redacted: true or the job has role vetting. Also plan an ACL change to limit access to a small group.

olivia_privacy: Checklist for closure: rotate keys, update ACLs, redact artifacts, file incident, add onboarding doc for eval datasets with PII guidance, add CI gates and metadata tagging.

sara_ml: Merging now. Will post merge commit and backfill status in infra channel.

raj_engineer: After merge I'll open follow-up to add unit tests that simulate quantized strides to avoid regression.

olivia_privacy: Thanks everyone. Quick reminder: don't paste real customer prompts in quick reproducer threads unless redacted. :warning:

mike_infra: :thumbsup: will post infra changes shortly in #eng-infra and send a brief to security ops.
